map.两端铰支细长压杆临界载荷：P_cr = π²·E·I ÷ L²（N；E 弹性模量: Critical load of a slender column hinged at both ends: P_cr = π²·E·I ÷ L² (N; E in Pa, I in m⁴, L in m); linked value: P_cr ÷ 1000 (kN). Validation: empty E, I or L returns "Please fill in the Length (m) before calculating."; L = 0 is caught by the denominator guard with "⚠ The Length (m) is the denominator of this calculation and cannot be 0." and stops. Example: E = 200 GPa, I = 1e-6 m⁴, L = 2 m → P_cr ≈ 493.48 kN. Criterion: no fixed grading; P_cr is proportional to E and I and inversely proportional to L²; applies only to both ends hinged (effective-length factor K = 1).
